problem_definition: Some external models cannot reliably access or read the chatgpt.site homepage, so GitHub must provide both model-readable files and a human-readable website path.

github_repository_channel.write_path: GitHub connector file creation and update

resolution.chosen_solution: Use GitHub repository for model-readable canonical files and GitHub Pages for human-readable GitHub-hosted browsing.
resolution.next_operational_unit: Open Actions and confirm the Deploy GitHub Pages workflow reaches a green check, then verify the public Pages URL.
